snippet.title: Portal 2: Thoughts - gameplay teaser | Portal detector demonstration
snippet.description:
Thoughts is a Portal 2 mod takes place after the events of Portal 2.
This map demonstrates the mechanics of new testing element - portal detector
(Map will not appear in the game)
